title: Rust route lookup aliases any IPv6 prefix by IID and rewrites authenticated paths
description: Security review P2. The convergence change adds RoutingTable::lookup_host_by_iid and makes Router::lookup_route fall back to it whenever exact/prefix lookup fails. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs then accepts a route whose last hop shares only dst[8..], overwrites that authenticated final hop with the caller-supplied full destination, and forwards it. Any noncanonical 02xx alias sharing a node IID is therefore treated as the node's route even though LICHEN has one exact key-derived primary address and the upper bytes are part of identity/routing authority. Remove prefix-agnostic IID fallback from routable address lookup; explicitly translate only between validated canonical link-local control and exact ygg_addr_from_pubkey identities; add negative alias/shadow-route tests.
